info.title: Rechargeables, Day to Year
info.subtitle: What to expect, and what to do when it slips

rows.title: 18-22 hours a charge
rows.desc: A normal waking day, with room to spare

rows.title: Streaming is the big draw
rows.desc: Long calls and TV shorten the day noticeably

rows.title: Charge overnight
rows.desc: Designed for it — the circuit stops when full

rows.title: Power cut? Use a power bank
rows.desc: Or a case with its own internal battery

rows.title: Cell lasts about 3 years
rows.desc: It fades gradually rather than failing

rows.title: Cases are replaceable
rows.desc: A failed case is not a reason for new aids
